title: Love Bombing Is Not Love
hook: This isn't love. It's a tactic.

scenes.caption: On the second date they said you were their soulmate. By the first week, future, kids, forever. It felt like a movie. It isn't.
scenes.caption_roman: On the second date they said you were their soulmate. By the first week, future, kids, forever. It felt like a movie. It isn't.

scenes.caption: It's called love bombing: overwhelming affection, gifts, and promises used to rush past your judgment.
scenes.caption_roman: It's called love bombing: overwhelming affection, gifts, and promises used to rush past your judgment.

scenes.caption: Real love grows with time. Love bombing is fast because fast doesn't give you space to see the pattern.
scenes.caption_roman: Real love grows with time. Love bombing is fast because fast doesn't give you space to see the pattern.

scenes.caption: Then comes the switch. The same intensity turns to anger if you want space, if you see friends, if you say no.
scenes.caption_roman: Then comes the switch. The same intensity turns to anger if you want space, if you see friends, if you say no.

scenes.caption: The affection was never about you. It was a hook. Once you're invested, the reward gets taken away to control you.
scenes.caption_roman: The affection was never about you. It was a hook. Once you're invested, the reward gets taken away to control you.

scenes.caption: Healthy people respect pace. They can wait. They don't need a lifetime commitment on day three.
scenes.caption_roman: Healthy people respect pace. They can wait. They don't need a lifetime commitment on day three.

scenes.caption: So set one boundary: tell them you want to slow down. A safe person stays calm. A controller gets angry. Watch that reaction. Follow Coercion Files for the psychology they don't teach you in school.
scenes.caption_roman: So set one boundary: tell them you want to slow down. A safe person stays calm. A controller gets angry. Watch that reaction. Follow Coercion Files for the psychology they don't teach you in school.
